title: 7-year-old boy with ear pain
arrival: A 7-year-old boy is brought in by his father for mild pain in his left ear that began yesterday.
keyCriterion: No red, yellow, or high-risk vital sign criteria met
feedbackWhy: This patient does not meet any red or yellow criteria and has no high-risk vital signs. He can safely wait for evaluation in the low-acuity area.
reassessment: As with all patients in the waiting area, he should undergo reassessment because his condition can change while waiting. His caregiver should be advised to notify staff if his symptoms worsen.

airway_red.text: No stridor. No central cyanosis. No respiratory distress.

circulation_red.text: No bleeding. No cold extremities. No signs of dehydration.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. No altered mental status, stiff neck or fever.

other_red.text: No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or surgical diagnosis.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Eating and drinking normally. No vomiting or diarrhoea.

disability_yellow.text: Comfortable. Not irritable or lethargic. Not in severe pain.

other_yellow.text: No rash, trauma, malnutrition or exposure requiring prophylaxis.

exampleShows: Every part of the card was checked and nothing was met.
Green is reached only after red, yellow and high-risk vital signs are all clear.
